## missing repositories get a record

ID: `project-graph-sync/missing-repositories-get-a-record`

Status: **implemented and tested**

A non-archived GitHub repository with neither a graph record nor a reason in `workspace_map_extras.yaml` SHALL be reported, and with `--write` SHALL be added as a record built from the settings. When GitHub cannot be read, or a would-be id collides, nothing SHALL be written (exit 1).

## settings come from config

ID: `project-graph-sync/settings-come-from-config`

Status: **implemented and tested**

The GitHub owner and accounts, `default_home`, `record_source` (`owner`, `other`) and the per-account `organizations` settings (`home`, `id_prefix`, `tags`, `utility_tags`) SHALL come from `graph-config.yaml` beside the project graph, and a missing value SHALL stop the run (exit 2) with a message naming where to set it, writing nothing.

Implemented by:

- `project_graph_sync` — [scripts/project_graph_sync.py:1](../../scripts/project_graph_sync.py#L1)

- Scenario `settings-come-from-config`: tested by `tests/test_project_graph_sync.py::test_a_missing_setting_stops_loudly_and_writes_nothing` ([tests/test_project_graph_sync.py:109](../../tests/test_project_graph_sync.py#L109)), `tests/test_project_graph_sync.py::test_write_adds_records_using_the_configured_settings` ([tests/test_project_graph_sync.py:118](../../tests/test_project_graph_sync.py#L118))
